manifest.scope: full-dimensional fixed-identity Enc/Dec with dense Gaussian algebraic test keys; NOT Extract outputs

metadata.platform: Darwin 25.6.0 arm64; native wall-time / correctness measurements; no Windows cycle counts or OS-enforced memory-cap claim; compiler=Apple LLVM 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
metadata.matrix_supplier: test-only AES-256-CTR; key=SHAKE256(version/profile/matrix_seed); 128-bit IV=BE64(global column)||BE64(0); each column uses fewer than 2^64 counter blocks; mask each residue to a bits
metadata.matrix_backend: macOS CommonCrypto, stream checked against OpenSSL AES-256-CTR in selftests
metadata.matrix_supplier_scope: synthetic pseudorandom fixed-identity matrix, not implemented Setup/PubEval and not a seeded-MPK compression claim
metadata.private_key: independent coordinate sampler D_Z,sigma with original finite truncation and interval coins; u=M e computed, not an output of trapdoor extraction; no Setup/Extract joint-distribution claim
metadata.timing_scope: Enc executes all fixed-identity scalar, M^T s, polar quantization and serialization operations. Enc core excludes test-matrix supply and resource/progress controls. Dec executes parsing, reconstruction, full private-key inner product and decision. Offline preparation, file I/O and extra validation separate. PubEval excluded.
metadata.message_policy: trial 0 encrypts 0, trial 1 encrypts 1, then alternates; fresh s, scalar noise, private tape and public seed each time
metadata.seed_note: Persisted fixture and diagnostic seeds are disposable synthetic test data, not real keys.
